data.text/markdown:
Extraction audit summary

The extraction audit was conducted on 8,166 document level records before any patient level processing.

Key findings

  • Total records: 8,166
  • Folder year mismatches: 431 (5.3%)
  • Raw unknown visit types in visit_type: 619 (7.6%)
  • Final unknown visit types in visit_type_final: 19 (0.2%)
  • Dates extracted from docx: 8,010 (98.1%)
  • High confidence dates with exact_anchor: 7,458 (91.3%)
  • Low confidence dates with fallback_single, fallback_scored, or month_only: 708 (8.7%)
  • Month only dates: 156 (1.9%)

Interpretation

Overall, extraction quality appears reasonably strong. Most records are based on docx sources, and a large majority of dates are classified as exact_anchor, which supports downstream temporal analysis. Document typing also improves substantially after post processing. The number of unknown records decreases from 619 in the raw visit_type field to 19 in visit_type_final, which supports using visit_type_final as the main document type variable in later steps.
